name: joint_v2_india10_20260907

metrics.harness: scripts/eval_inria.py (pooled IoU, 25 official val tiles) and scripts/eval_india_osm.py on blocks disjoint from every training AOI

india_heldout_blocks_at_0.50._note: Blocks disjoint from all training AOIs. OSM-anchored RECALL only - OSM is incomplete in India, so precision and IoU here measure the reference, not the model (fact 28).

bangalore_cvraman_CONTAMINATED._warning: NOT a held-out number. bangalore_cvraman_a fully contains the CV Raman Nagar benchmark block and all 30 of its tiles are in this model's training set, because train_inria.py --extra-data-dir holds nothing out. The same is true of joint_v3. Only finetune_osm (which used --holdout-aoi bangalore_cvraman_a) has a clean Bangalore number. Use the held-out city blocks above instead.

limitations: Merges adjacent roofs into single blobs in dense blocks, so building COUNT is less reliable than area.
Indian evaluation is OSM-anchored recall on machine-labelled training regions; no hand-drawn eval set exists for the eight new cities.

Predicts ~2x the detected area of the shipped model in India. Coverage analysis says that is more correct, not less (shipped predicts 11.5% of a dense Delhi block as roof against a realistic 40-60%), but it has not been verified against hand-drawn ground truth.
